title: Beef and Pilaf Stew
description: A hearty beef stew made with pilaf and a hint of Russian spices.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add beef and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add pilaf and cook, stirring constantly, for 2 minutes.
Add winey and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
